newsitem.title: USA: Questar to spend $1.5 billion over next 5 years.
newsitem.headline: Questar to spend $1.5 billion over next 5 years.

text.p: Questar Corp., an energy services holding company, said Tuesday it plans to spend up to $1.5 billion over the next five years in a plan to boost its capital-growth projects by 50 percent.

Questar President R.D. Cash said that 60 percent to 70 percent of the spending increases are earmarked for such non-regulated projects as oil and gas exploration and for reserve acquisition. A spokesman said most of the exploration projects are in the Rocky Mountain region.

"This increased non-regulated emphasis should increase earnings and improve market valuation over the five-year period," Cash said in comments to shareholders at the annual meeting of the Rock Springs, Wyo.-based company.
Cash called the move "the most aggressive growth programme in our history."
Questar's stock fell 12.5 cents to 12.5 cents $39.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
